images.screen: A · 두드림 — someone knocks back from beneath the ice
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person view looking straight down at black lake ice at 4 a.m., the tips of the player's own dark winter boots at the bottom edge. The ice is deep teal-black and glassy with drifting frost haze, fine silver hairline cracks, trapped air bubbles and falling snow. Just beneath the surface a pale, water-distorted human hand is pressed flat against the underside of the ice, the forearm fading into darkness, a thin column of bubbles rising beside it; soft concentric knock ripples glow around the palm. A faint second hand waits further away toward the upper left, suggesting a direction to follow. Muted cyan moonlight, heavy vignette, subtle film grain. Minimal thin Korean typography: floating letters "톡 톡 톡" near the hand, a bottom-left line "그 손은 북서쪽으로 옮겨 간다" with a small progress row, and a quiet two-line poem at bottom-right. Eerie, intimate, silent.

images.screen: B · 끝 — the ending, seen from under the ice
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The perspective is inverted: we are now under the ice, looking up. The frozen surface is a luminous pale-cyan ceiling with rippling caustic light and a blurred full moon glowing through it; soft god rays fall down into dark blue water. Above the ice, blurred dark boot soles of a person standing and looking down, and a line of footprints walking away. In the center foreground, our own pale hand reaches up and presses against the underside of the ice, water-distorted and fading to deep blue at the wrist; fine strands of dark hair drift up from the bottom edge and small bubbles rise. Cool palette from white-cyan to abyssal navy, strong vignette. Large thin, widely spaced Korean text centered low "이번엔 내가 두드린다" with a small caption beneath and a tiny ending tag. Haunting, beautiful, quiet ending.
